criterion.description: Given the project, when I check `env.example`, then it includes all required environment variables with descriptions (LLM API keys, Telegram bot token, Brave Search API key, Stock API key, agentic-memories service URL, Redis configuration, Service ports and URLs)
Given environment setup, when I run `./run_docker.sh`, then it interactively creates `.env` file from `env.example` if missing
Given environment variables, when services start, then all required variables are validated and missing variables cause clear error messages
Given environment variables, when I check security, then sensitive values (API keys, tokens) are never logged or exposed in error messages
Given environment configuration, when services start, then environment-specific values (dev/staging/prod) can be configured via `.env` file
Given the `.env` file, when I check `.gitignore`, then `.env` is excluded from version control

doc.title: Epic and Story Breakdown
doc.snippet: As a developer, I want environment configuration and secrets management, so that I can securely configure Annie without hardcoding sensitive data.

doc.title: Epic 1 Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Environment variables defined for all services including LLM provider, API keys, service URLs, Redis configuration, and logging levels.

doc.title: Architecture Plan
doc.snippet: Secrets management via environment variables, .env file excluded from version control, sensitive data masking in logs.

constraint.description: Sensitive values (API keys, tokens) must never be logged or exposed in error messages
constraint.impact: Error messages must mask sensitive values (show only first 4 and last 4 characters)

constraint.description: Environment variable names must match docker-compose.yml references exactly
constraint.impact: env.example must use GROK_API_KEY (not XAI_API_KEY), CHATGPT_API_KEY (not OPENAI_API_KEY), BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY (not BRAVE_API_KEY)

constraint.description: run_docker.sh must be in scripts/ directory
Environment validation must occur on service startup
constraint.impact: Config modules must be importable and validate on import/initialization

constraint.description: .env file must be excluded from version control
constraint.impact: Already configured in .gitignore, verify it's working

interface.name: env.example
interface.signature:
# Annie Environment Configuration Template # Copy this file to .env and fill in your actual values # DO NOT commit .env to version control
# Environment Type (dev/staging/prod) ENVIRONMENT=dev
# LLM Provider Configuration LLM_PROVIDER=grok-4 GROK_API_KEY=your-grok-api-key-here CHATGPT_API_KEY=your-chatgpt-api-key-here
# Telegram Bot TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=your-telegram-bot-token-here
# Tool API Keys BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY=your-brave-search-api-key-here STOCK_API_KEY=your-stock-api-key-here
# External Services AGENTIC_MEMORIES_URL=http://host.docker.internal:8080
# Redis Configuration REDIS_HOST=redis REDIS_PORT=6379
# Service Configuration BACKEND_PORT=8000 BACKEND_URL=http://backend:8000 MCP_SERVER_NAME=mcp-server
# Logging LOG_LEVEL=INFO
interface.description: Template file with all required environment variables and descriptions
